page.overview:
What is S-Mine Detonator?

S-Mine Detonators, or Photon Grenades, were detonators used by the Eighth Brother, an Imperial Inquisitor. He was equipped with the small detonators on multiple occasions, including early in the Imperial Era and on a search for the former Sith Lord Maul on the planet Malachor in 3 BBY. When the Eighth Brother encountered the Jedi Kanan Jarrus, his apprentice Ezra Bridger, and the former Jedi Ahsoka Tano on Malachor, the outnumbered Inquisitor threw three S-Mine Detonators at them, allowing himself to retreat.

S-Mine Detonators, also known as Photon Grenades, were small, disk-shaped explosives carried by the Imperial Inquisitor Eighth Brother. Gray and black in color, the detonators could be attached to a belt for easy access. The Eighth Brother typically carried several of them at once. The detonators glowed red when armed, and upon detonation, they exploded into various colors.

In 19 BBY, the Eighth Brother wore the detonators on Coruscant. in 14 BBY. In 3 BBY, the Eighth Brother brought several S-Mine Detonators to the planet Malachor as he tracked down the former Sith Lord Maul. When the Eighth Brother came across the Jedi Kanan Jarrus, his apprentice Ezra Bridger, and the former Jedi Ahsoka Tano, he hurled three S-Mine Detonators at the trio as they charged forward. The explosions collapsed the ground below Bridger, causing him to fall through and providing the outnumbered Inquisitor an opportunity to flee.

The Sith Lord Darth Sidious later depicted S-Mine Detonators in a visualization of the Inquisitors, including the Eighth Brother, in The Secrets of the Sith, a book that he wrote before his death during the Battle of Exegol in 35 ABY.
